<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 114.06808. Assuming this is the molecular ion (M⁺·), the neutral mass is 114.06808 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass is C₆H₁₀O₂ (12·6 + 1.007825·10 + 15.994915·2 = 114.06808 Da) and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2). No other elements are indicated, so the molecular formula is C6H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
